### Fig6A. genome_diff ###

df <- read_excel("6A_A_ihumii_10.xlsx")

# Data preprocessing
df_sankey <- df %>%
  separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>% 
  mutate(geneID = str_trim(geneID))   

order_levels <- df %>% arrange(desc(GRatio)) %>% pull(Description)
df$Description <- factor(df$Description, levels = order_levels)
df_sankey$Description <- factor(df_sankey$Description, levels = order_levels)

# Calculate -log10(Pvalue)
df$logP <- -log10(df$pvalue)

# Define a color palette
my_colors <- c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00", 
               "#FFFF33", "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#999999", "#66C2A5")

sankey_colors <- colorRampPalette(my_colors)(length(unique(df_sankey$Description)))

# p_left
p_left <- ggplot(df_sankey, aes(axis1 = geneID, axis2 = Description, y = 1)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Description), width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3, curve_type = "sigmoid") +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.1, aes(fill = Description, color = Description), alpha = 1) +
  
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", 
            aes(label = ifelse(after_stat(x) == 1, as.character(after_stat(stratum)), NA)),
            hjust = 1,        
            nudge_x = -0.1,   
            size = 3.5) +
  
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", 
            aes(label = ifelse(after_stat(x) == 2, as.character(after_stat(stratum)), NA)),
            hjust = 1,        
            nudge_x = -0.06,  
            size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2.5, 2.05), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sankey_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sankey_colors) +
  theme_void() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = -2, b = 10, l = 10) 
  )

# p_right
p_right <- ggplot(df, aes(x = GRatio, y = Description)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = logP)) +
  
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = expression(-log[10](P))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6), breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5)) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 4), limits = c(0.5, 5.5)) +
  
  labs(x = "Mean_diff", y = NULL) + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed"), 
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    legend.position = "right", 
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 0) 
  )

# Combine Plots
fig6A <- p_left + p_right + plot_layout(widths = c(2.2, 1))

print(fig6A)

ggsave("fig6A.pdf", fig6A, width = 11, height = 6)


### Fig6B. pangenome ###

df <- readr::read_csv("6B_pangenome.csv")

gene_order <- c("ramA", "bglX", "Flr", "Fcr", "phy", "Chi")

# data processing
presence_data <- df %>%
  filter(mapping_status == "mapped") %>%
  group_by(species, target_gene) %>%
  arrange(desc(bitscore)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(presence_value = case_when(
    gene_category == "core" ~ 2,
    gene_category == "accessory" ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )) %>%
  select(species, target_gene, presence_value)

full_grid <- expand_grid(
  species    = unique(df$species),
  target_gene = gene_order
)

heatmap_df <- full_grid %>%
  left_join(presence_data, by = c("species", "target_gene")) %>%
  mutate(
    presence_value = replace_na(presence_value, 0),
    target_gene    = factor(target_gene, levels = gene_order)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = target_gene,
    values_from = presence_value,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(heatmap_df) <- heatmap_df$species
heatmap_df$species <- NULL

heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_df)

missing_genes <- setdiff(gene_order, colnames(heatmap_mat))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  for (g in missing_genes) {
    heatmap_mat <- cbind(heatmap_mat, setNames(list(rep(0, nrow(heatmap_mat))), g))
  }
}

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[, gene_order, drop = FALSE]

# fig6B
color_palette    <- c("white", "#6BAED6", "#D73027")
breaks_for_color <- c(-0.5, 0.5, 1.5, 2.5)

pdf_height <- max(6, nrow(heatmap_mat) * 0.2)

fig6B <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  main           = "Distribution of Flavonoid Degradation Genes Across Bacterial Species",
  color          = color_palette,
  breaks         = breaks_for_color,
  cluster_rows   = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,   
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  show_colnames  = TRUE,
  fontsize       = 10,
  fontsize_row   = 9,
  fontsize_col   = 10,
  cellwidth      = 18,
  cellheight     = 13,
  angle_col      = 45,
  display_numbers = FALSE,
  legend         = TRUE,
  legend_breaks  = c(0.5, 1.5, 2.5),
  legend_labels  = c("Absent", "Accessory", "Core"),
  border_color   = "grey60",
  na_col         = "white",
  filename       = NA       
)

print(fig6B)

ggsave("fig6B.pdf", fig6B, width = 10, height = pdf_height)


### Fig6 and S7. metabolism ###

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14))

overview_data <- read_excel("metabolism.xlsx")

id_col_name   <- "ID"
name_col_name <- "compound name"

all_cols    <- names(overview_data)
sample_cols <- setdiff(all_cols, c(id_col_name, name_col_name))

metadata <- tibble(
  Sample = sample_cols,
  Group  = factor(sub("_(.*)$", "", sample_cols))
)

abundance_data <- overview_data %>%
  select(all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  as.matrix()

if (any(!sapply(abundance_data, is.numeric))) {
  abundance_data <- apply(abundance_data, 2, as.numeric)
}

metabolite_ids <- overview_data[[id_col_name]]
if (any(duplicated(metabolite_ids))) {
  metabolite_ids <- make.unique(paste(metabolite_ids, seq_len(nrow(overview_data)), sep = "_"))
}
rownames(abundance_data) <- metabolite_ids

metabolite_metadata <- overview_data %>%
  select(all_of(c(id_col_name, name_col_name))) %>%
  rename(
    ID   = !!id_col_name,
    Name = !!name_col_name
  ) %>%
  mutate(ID = metabolite_ids)

abundance_t <- t(abundance_data)

## Handle NA / zeros 
if (!any(abundance_t > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop("No positive values in abundance data.")
}

if (any(is.na(abundance_t)) || any(abundance_t == 0)) {
  min_val_positive <- min(abundance_t[abundance_t > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (any(is.na(abundance_t))) {
    abundance_t[is.na(abundance_t)] <- min_val_positive / 2
  }
  if (any(abundance_t == 0)) {
    abundance_t[abundance_t == 0] <- min_val_positive / 2
  }
}

## 2. PCA 
abundance_scaled <- scale(log2(abundance_t), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

if (!all(rownames(abundance_scaled) == metadata$Sample)) {
  stop("Row names of abundance_scaled do not match metadata$Sample order.")
}

pca_result <- prcomp(abundance_scaled, scale. = FALSE, center = FALSE)

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "Sample")

group_order_for_side_plots <- sort(unique(metadata$Group))
pca_scores$Group <- factor(pca_scores$Group, levels = group_order_for_side_plots)
metadata$Group   <- factor(metadata$Group,   levels = group_order_for_side_plots)

pca_variance <- summary(pca_result)$importance %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  slice(2) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "PC", values_to = "Variance") %>%
  mutate(PC_label = paste0(PC, " (", sprintf("%.2f", Variance * 100), "%)"))

all_groups <- levels(metadata$Group)
default_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(all_groups)), "Set1")
group_colors <- setNames(default_colors[seq_along(all_groups)], all_groups)

## 3. PERMANOVA 
permanova_p_value   <- NA
permanova_r_squared <- NA

tryCatch({
  dist_matrix <- dist(abundance_scaled, method = "euclidean")
  adonis_result <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Group, data = metadata, permutations = 999)
  permanova_r_squared <- round(adonis_result$R2[1], 3)
  permanova_p_value  <- round(adonis_result$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)
}, error = function(e) {})

permanova_text <- if (!is.na(permanova_r_squared) && !is.na(permanova_p_value)) {
  paste0("R=", permanova_r_squared, ", P=", permanova_p_value)
} else {
  ""
}

## 4. PCA plots

## 5. Differential analysis 
metabolite_metadata <- metabolite_metadata %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID))

log2_abundance <- log2(abundance_t)
stopifnot(all(rownames(log2_abundance) == metadata$Sample))

diff_test_two_groups <- function(group1, group2, metadata, log2_abundance) {
  samples_g1 <- metadata %>%
    filter(Group == group1) %>%
    pull(Sample)
  samples_g2 <- metadata %>%
    filter(Group == group2) %>%
    pull(Sample)
  
  if (length(samples_g1) < 2 | length(samples_g2) < 2) {
    stop(paste0("Group ", group1, " or ", group2, " has < 2 samples."))
  }
  
  mat_g1 <- log2_abundance[rownames(log2_abundance) %in% samples_g1, , drop = FALSE]
  mat_g2 <- log2_abundance[rownames(log2_abundance) %in% samples_g2, , drop = FALSE]
  
  res_list <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(log2_abundance)), function(j) {
    x <- mat_g1[, j]
    y <- mat_g2[, j]
    
    p_val <- tryCatch({
      t.test(x, y)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    
    data.frame(
      ID      = colnames(log2_abundance)[j],
      log2FC  = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
      pvalue  = p_val,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  
  diff_res <- bind_rows(res_list) %>%
    mutate(
      ID    = as.character(ID),
      FDR   = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
      FDR   = ifelse(FDR == 0 | is.na(FDR), 1e-300, FDR),
      negLog10FDR = -log10(FDR),
      Direction = case_when(
        log2FC > 0  ~ paste0("Up in ", group1),
        log2FC < 0  ~ paste0("Down in ", group1),
        TRUE        ~ "No change"
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(metabolite_metadata, by = "ID") %>%
    mutate(
      Metabolite = ifelse(is.na(Name) | Name == "", ID, Name)
    )
  
  diff_res
}

group_gam  <- "GAM"
group_y120 <- "Y120"
group_y294 <- "Y294"

diff_Y120_vs_GAM  <- diff_test_two_groups(group_y120, group_gam,  metadata, log2_abundance)
diff_Y294_vs_GAM  <- diff_test_two_groups(group_y294, group_gam,  metadata, log2_abundance)
diff_Y120_vs_Y294 <- diff_test_two_groups(group_y120, group_y294, metadata, log2_abundance)

## 6. Bubble plots vs GAM 
bubble_all <- bind_rows(
  diff_Y120_vs_GAM %>% mutate(Comparison = "Y120 / GAM"),
  diff_Y294_vs_GAM %>% mutate(Comparison = "Y294 / GAM")
)

top_n_bubble <- 40

bubble_top <- bubble_all %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_bubble) %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = c("Y120 / GAM", "Y294 / GAM"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Comparison) %>%
  arrange(log2FC, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = unique(Metabolite))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

bubble_color_limits <- c(
  min(bubble_top$log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(bubble_top$log2FC, na.rm = TRUE)
)

p_bubble_diff <- ggplot(bubble_top,
                        aes(x = Comparison, y = Metabolite)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = negLog10FDR, color = log2FC),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(3, 10),
    name  = expression(-log[10]("FDR"))
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low      = "#4575B4",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "#D73027",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits   = bubble_color_limits,
    name     = "log2FC"
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = NULL,
    title = "Differential metabolites vs GAM"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
                                   color  = "black", size = 12),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.key      = element_blank(),
    axis.line       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    plot.margin        = unit(c(0.5, 0.8, 0.5, 1.4), "cm")
  )

ggsave("figS7C.pdf",
       plot = p_bubble_diff, width = 7, height = 9, dpi = 600)

## Volcano plot: Y120 vs Y294

volcano_data <- diff_Y120_vs_Y294 %>%
  mutate(
    Regulation = case_when(
      log2FC > 0  ~ paste0("Up in ", group_y120),
      log2FC < 0  ~ paste0("Up in ", group_y294),
      TRUE        ~ "No change"
    ),
    Regulation = factor(Regulation,
                        levels = c(paste0("Up in ", group_y120),
                                   paste0("Up in ", group_y294),
                                   "No change"))
  )

volcano_colors <- c(
  "Up in Y120" = "#D73027",
  "Up in Y294" = "#4575B4",
  "No change"  = "grey70"
)

label_n <- 20
label_volcano <- volcano_data %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
  slice_head(n = label_n)

p_volcano_Y120_Y294 <- ggplot(volcano_data,
                              aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10FDR, color = Regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_volcano,
    aes(label = Metabolite),
    size          = 3,
    max.overlaps  = 100,
    box.padding   = 0.3,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    segment.color = "grey50"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("log2(Fold Change) (", group_y120, " / ", group_y294, ")"),
    y = expression(-log[10]("FDR")),
    title = paste0("Volcano plot: ", group_y120, " vs ", group_y294)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text       = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title      = element_text(color = "black")
  )

ggsave("fig6C.pdf",
       plot = p_volcano_Y120_Y294, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 600)


## Q/T selection and long-format data (for Q→Tax plots)

metabolites_of_interest <- c("Quercetin", "Taxifolin")

id_col_name   <- "ID"
name_col_name <- "compound name"

all_cols    <- names(overview_data)
sample_cols <- setdiff(all_cols, c(id_col_name, name_col_name))

groups_keep <- c("GAM", "Y120", "Y294")

sample_info <- tibble(
  Sample = sample_cols,
  Group  = sub("_(.*)$", "", sample_cols)
) %>%
  filter(Group %in% groups_keep)

sample_cols_keep <- sample_info$Sample

df_plot <- overview_data %>%
  filter(!!sym(name_col_name) %in% metabolites_of_interest) %>%
  select(
    !!sym(id_col_name),
    !!sym(name_col_name),
    all_of(sample_cols_keep)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(sample_cols_keep),
    names_to  = "Sample",
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = sub("_(.*)$", "", Sample)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    ID         = !!sym(id_col_name),
    Metabolite = !!sym(name_col_name)
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, Group, Metabolite, Expression, ID) %>%
  mutate(
    Group      = factor(Group, levels = c("GAM", "Y120", "Y294")),
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = metabolites_of_interest)
  )

## Q→Tax boxplot version

df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  mutate(
    Group      = factor(Group, levels = c("GAM", "Y120", "Y294")),
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite, levels = c("Quercetin", "Taxifolin"))
  )

low_threshold <- 0.1

samples_remove <- df_plot %>%
  filter(Group == "Y120") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    max_expr = max(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(max_expr < low_threshold) %>%
  pull(Sample)

df_plot_filt <- df_plot %>%
  filter(!(Group == "Y120" & Sample %in% samples_remove))

metabolite_colors_box <- c(
  "Quercetin" = "#4DBBD5FF",
  "Taxifolin" = "#E64B35FF"
)

annot_df_box <- tibble(
  x     = c(1.5, 2.5),
  label = c("ns", "* (p < 0.05)")
)

y_top_box <- max(df_plot_filt$Expression, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15

p_expression_box <- ggplot(df_plot_filt, aes(x = Group, y = Expression)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Metabolite),
    position     = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    width        = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color        = "black",
    linewidth    = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Metabolite),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      dodge.width  = 0.6,
      jitter.width = 0.08
    ),
    size  = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5),
    linetype   = "dashed",
    color      = "grey75",
    linewidth  = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = annot_df_box,
    aes(x = x, y = y_top_box, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust       = 0,
    size        = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = metabolite_colors_box, name = "Metabolite") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metabolite_colors_box, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Expression Level"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.border    = element_blank(),
    axis.line       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.margin     = unit(c(0.8, 1, 0.8, 0.8), "cm")
  )

ggsave("fig6D.pdf",
       plot = p_expression_box, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 600)
